descriptions.preferred: The leaves are slightly larger than those of most dissectums, but otherwise typical. They are divided into seven to nine lobes, each lobe narrowly and deeply cut to the midrib. The distinguishing feature is that, because the lobes are held close together, they cascade and have a more flowing appearance. The foliage is a bright green and stands full sun well. Fall color is brilliant gold suffused with crimson. Acer This cultivar is hardy and beautiful. The original plant in New Jersey was 10 ft. (3 m) high and 13 ft. (4 m) wide.

rhs.description: A deciduous shrub or small tree, to around 2. 5m high, with a weeping habit forming a dense mound of lacy foliage. Leaves are bright green, and deeply cut into narrow, feathery lobes, turning bright shades of yellow, orange and red in the autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, though some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour; will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring, especially when grown in containers , to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好、排水良好、最好为微酸性的土壤中，种植位置应避风，并防止干燥风侵袭。半阴环境下生长最佳，但需要一定日照以促进叶色表现；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。春季应覆盖 mulch，尤其是容器栽培时，可帮助保持土壤水分。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶灌木或小乔木，高约 2. 5 米，具明显垂枝习性，可形成由细 laceleaf 状叶丛构成的致密圆 mound。 叶片鲜绿色，深裂为狭窄、羽毛状裂片，秋季转为明亮的黄色、橙色和红色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合用于造型景观、城市／庭院花园、乡村风／自然式花园、低维护花园，以及露台／容器栽培。
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片较大于多数 dissectum 类品种，但其余特征较为典型。 叶通常分裂为 7 至 9 裂，每裂片狭长，并深裂近中脉。 其鉴别特征在于裂片彼此靠拢，因此整体呈瀑布般下垂，观感更为流畅飘逸。 叶色鲜绿，较耐全日照。 秋色为明亮的金黄色，并晕染绯红。 该品种既耐寒又优美。 最初的新泽西原株高 10 英尺（3 米），冠幅 13 英尺（4 米）。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Waterfall' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Waterfall' Weeping Green Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Waterfall' is a great weeping green laceleaf Japanese maple with a show in the fall. This Japanese maple tree is very heat tolerant and can grow in either sun or shade conditions. 'Waterfall' has very pendulous and its cascading look that gives it its name. The leaf is slightly larger than many other green dissectums. This tree can grow slightly wider than it does tall reaching 5 ft in height by 6 ft in width in 10 years. The ‘Waterfall’ Japanese maple makes an excellent large potted patio tree but can also be used as specimen plant in any landscape. The spring color is a bright almost neon green and the fall color ranges from yellow to gold. After years of observation, we believe ‘Waterfall’ and ‘Viridis’ to now be the exact same cultivar in the nursery trade today. The original ‘Waterfall’ was likely a ‘Viridis’ that happened to be at waterfall at a state park in New Jersey. We still sell both cultivars as both are popular names people know this selection by.
